commands.cache_environment: XDG_CACHE_HOME same for first and second public runs; PYTHONPATH cleared; unchanged workbook bytes

conditions.A: ordinary installed-venv Python/openpyxl full workload invocation
conditions.B: prior frozen RC cold from-zero invocation; reference existing measurements unless matched measurement necessary
conditions.C: public RC run with a valid, fresh index created by a prior public invocation in same cache before scored timer

contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.bootstrap: 10000 workload resamples, seed 20261012, percentile 95% interval for median and geometric mean ratio
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.break_even: I + N*C < N*A; no break-even if C>=A; smallest integer N satisfying strict inequality
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.cache: prepare index with public RC path before each scored C; unchanged bytes; verify reused after each C; no warm measurement if rebuilt
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.endpoint: WARM_TOTAL_PRODUCT_INVOCATION_WALL_TIME; C/A per supported eligible workload
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.exactness: zero new normalized semantic mismatches versus A; known prior failures remain recorded
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.materiality: median ratio <=0.90, most workloads faster, upper bootstrap median-ratio bound <1, not concentrated in two workloads
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.order: eligible then representative IDs in prior frozen manifest order; within each workload A,C counterbalanced ABBAA/BAABB by workload index parity
contingent_scored_timing_if_feasible.unit: workload, median scored invocation wall time

feasibility_probe.procedure: Copy exact prior workload script and workbook into one workdir; invoke public RC twice with same workdir and XDG_CACHE_HOME; do not mutate workbook; inspect per-run summaries and manifests for run IDs, rebuilt flags, DB paths, acceleration contact, and output equality. Probe timings are not scored.
feasibility_probe.success_rule: Second public invocation must use preexisting index without rebuild and without internal manifest/env overrides.

populations.supported_rule: Prior frozen semantic_forensics classification is not GENUINE_SEMANTIC_OR_EXIT_MISMATCH; retain all known failures in all-workload record.

scientific_question: Can packaged librecalc-agent 0.2.0rc1 reuse a previously built valid index across public run invocations, and if so does warm full invocation accelerate the frozen workloads?
stop_rule: If feasibility fails, do not run scored A/C timings or estimate warm ratios, index-build cost, or amortization. Preserve prior cold result; report inability to support warm state.
title: RC warm/index-ready feasibility-gated characterization
